content.value: Draw and explain the different characteristics curves of a DC shunt generator. A 4 pole generator having wave wound armature winding with 51 slots each slot containing 20 conductors. What will be the voltage generated when driven at 1500 r.p.m.? Assuming the flux per pole to be 7 mWb.
